```yaml
name: Rebuild Model Site

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  rebuild_site:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          all_but_latest: true
          only_status: "in_progress"

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up UV
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          activate-environment: "policyengine"
          ignore-empty-workdir: false
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run pytest -q

      - name: Rebuild model site
        run: uv run python -m policyengine_us.build_site
```
